description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Migration package, which includes functions for migrating repository layouts between different versions of git-svn and SVN integration, as well as utility functions for repository configuration management.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from v0 layout to newer layouts by updating references and repository data in the git directory.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from v1 layout to a newer layout, primarily by moving info/ URLs and repository data.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from v2 layout to current layout, based on SVN configuration detection.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by reducing redundant URL fetches, reusing existing relays, and cleaning up configuration sections.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Runs all migration procedures sequentially and optionally minimizes connections, ensuring repository data adheres to the latest layout standards.
